name: TheDawn

components.pose: Fast, powerful ascent: she shoots up out of the sea standing upright on a towering column of water, arms swept wide and up, head thrown back then lifting, hair and gown streaming, caught at the moment the water is fully released; exultant expression with eyes on the camera; full figure from head to toe visible above the waterline.
components.effects: Great sheets and arcs of sea water cascade back down around her, spray and droplets frozen mid-air catching the sunrise, rainbow light in the mist, ripples spreading outward across the surface, a glow of {{MAGIC}} in the water.

notes: THE DAWN: the sister rising from the Sundering in her element's homeland - first look at her territory. Her dragon is not yet bound, so no companion; native creatures instead. Rise speed and energy differ per sister.
